comments.body: How do you start building trading bot?

replies.author: Kekoakalak
replies.body: i try to make my own strategy from established industry, i dont always go 1:1 so i do some adjustment on what feels logical or i think that works and then test it. Some Claude/deepseek/gpt assistant with starting or building the framework of the project helps and saves a lot of time.

replies.body: yeah but what tech. just tell the llm to build you a bot based on your strategy and parameters? connected to what brokerage?

comments.author: RepairSubstantial735
comments.body: Interested to see more on your bot.

replies.author: Kekoakalak
replies.body:
will let it run for about a week at 1.5% - 3% stop loss upon recovery.  
and then ill do another test with a steeper stop loss at about 5-7% stop loss.

losses that reach -1.5% are 90% going over  -2% to -4% losses as what i see in my logs.  
so ill let this run for a week then do another test for steeper 5-6% stop loss to see if the risk is worth it.
